sources.title: BRD Versioning Decision
sources.summary: Any material BRD edit creates a new version and requires fresh approval.

sources.title: Segregation of Duties Policy
sources.summary: Authors cannot be the sole approvers of governed work.

sources.title: Git Traceability Convention
sources.summary: Requirement identifiers must appear in issues, branches, commits and pull requests.

sources.title: Acceptance Coverage Rule
sources.summary: Every acceptance criterion requires test evidence or an approved waiver.

sources.title: QA Handoff Checklist
sources.summary: Handoff includes scope, criteria, code references, review findings, test evidence, defects and limitations.
